title: Liria 07 – Signs of Change
story:
The forest was unusually quiet.

Liria knelt beside a young tree whose leaves shimmered with a gentle blue light.

"Interesting..."

She carefully touched one of the leaves.

A faint tingling sensation traveled across her fingertips.

The plant was reacting to magical energy. But the intensity was unusual.

"This species shouldn't be growing here at all."

"That's what the others say, too."

Liria looked up.

An elderly forest warden stood a few paces away.

"The plants have been changing for several weeks," he explained. "Some grow faster, while others develop strange colors."

"And the animals?"

"Some have moved away. But we've also discovered new species."

Liria took out a small notebook.

Together they examined several parts of the forest. They compared plants, observed insects, and marked the changes on a map.

At last they reached a clearing.

There stood an ancient tree, its roots threaded with delicate, glowing lines.

Liria studied it for a long time.

She could sense the unusual energy. But instead of intervening immediately, she decided to keep watching how things developed.

"Is it dangerous?" the warden asked.

"We don't know yet."

"Then what should we do?"

Liria closed her notebook.

"Stay alert. We understand changes better when we first take the time to listen to them."

The warden nodded.

On the way back, Liria glanced once more toward the clearing.

Novaris was constantly evolving.

And even for one of its founders, this world still held surprises.

Not every change had to be prevented. Some needed to be understood first.
